record.question:
Five years ago, A was thrice as old as B and ten years later, A shall be twice as old as B. The present age
       of B is:
record.explanation: Let present ages be A,B. A−5=3(B−5) gives A=3B−10; A+10=2(B+10) gives A=2B+10. Hence B=20.
